# Gitlytics Dashboard Workspace

> Hosted cloud analytics workspace and visual dashboard for Gitlytics. Connect GitHub accounts to automatically monitor repository views, clones, referrers, and star growth.

## Key Dashboard Links

- [Cloud Dashboard App](https://dashboard.gitlytics.dev) : Interactive web application workspace.
- [Full AI Context](https://dashboard.gitlytics.dev/llms-full.txt) : Complete plain-text documentation for LLM consumption.
- [Homepage](https://gitlytics.dev) : Main Gitlytics landing page.
- [Documentation](https://docs.gitlytics.dev) : Setup guides, CLI commands, and Python library docs.
- [Blog](https://blog.gitlytics.dev) : Engineering articles and release notes.

## Main Dashboard Capabilities

1. **GitHub OAuth Workspace** : Connect your GitHub account to automatically track and sync private or public repository metrics.
2. **Interactive Visual Charts** : Real-time area, bar, line, and heatmap charts tracking views, unique visitors, clones, and stargazers over time.
3. **Traffic Referrers & Content Paths** : Breakdown of top referring sites and most popular content paths inside your repositories.
4. **Export Options** : Export reports and developer cards as high-resolution PNG or PDF images for READMEs and portfolios.
5. **Dynamic SVG Badges & Developer Cards** : Customizer engine for generating GitHub README stats cards, streak counters, and technology brand capsules.
